articles.headline: Mammoth hold off late charge from Penguins for 5-4 win
articles.description: — Clayton Keller, Kevin Stenlund, Nate Schmidt and Nick Schmaltz all tallied a goal and an assist to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-4 on Monday night.

articles.headline: Fueled by 'electric' MSG crowd, resurgent Rangers improve to 6-0-0 on home ice
articles.description: With a 5-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday night at Madison Square Garden, the New York Rangers improved to 6-0-0 in their first six home games, matching the second-longest season-opening home winning streak in franchise history.

articles.headline: Gavin McKenna scores and the Maple Leafs end a 3-game slide with 3-1 win over the Sharks
articles.description: — Gavin McKenna scored the go-ahead goal on a third-period power play and the Toronto Maple Leafs snapped a three-game slide Monday night with a 3-1 victory over the San Jose Sharks.

articles.headline: Matvei Michkov scores 2 goals and Flyers beat Avalanche 3-2 for 2nd straight win
articles.description: — Matvei Michkov scored two goals and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Monday night for their second straight victory after opening the season with nine consecutive losses.
